ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Product Defective or Unsatisfactory"), ISPICKVAL(Goods_Or_Services_Returned__c,'Y'), OR( ISBLANK(Description), OR( ISPICKVAL(Goods_Or_Services_Returned__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Goods_Or_Services_Returned__c, 'NA') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Goods_Or_Services_Returned__c,'Y'), ISBLANK(Date_Goods_Were_Returned_Or_Services_can__c) ), ISBLANK(Merchant_Description__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Description of Issue, Goods Or Services Returned, Goods Returned or Service Cancelled Date, What Happened with Merchant?
